title: Oman opens temporary Strait of Hormuz maritime corridor
summary: Oman has announced the establishment of a temporary maritime corridor through the Strait of Hormuz, following coordination with the International Maritime Organisation (IMO) and understandings reached between the United States and Iran.

title: Rupee depreciates further against US Dollar
summary: The Sri Lankan Rupee depreciated further against the US Dollar today (24), with the selling rate crossing the Rs. 340 mark, according to the latest exchange rates released by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka.

title: 19-year-old girl missing from Hali Ela
summary: Police have requested public assistance to trace a 19-year-old girl reported missing from the Hali Ela area.

title: Tourist arrivals cross 1.1 million mark
summary: Sri Lanka has recorded more than 1.1 million tourist arrivals between January 1 and June 21 this year, reflecting the continued recovery of the country’s tourism sector, according to the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority (SLTDA).

title: Police officers involved in Deraniyagala clash will be penalised if found guilty: Minister
summary: Police officers who were involved in the clash in Deraniyagala recently will be penalised if found guilty, Minister of Public Security Ananda Wijepala told Parliament today.

title: National Environment Amendment Bill unconditional: Opposition
summary: The Opposition in Parliament today argued that the National Environment Amendment Bill is unconditional as it violates the 13th Amendment.

title: Extreme heat forces school closures across Britain
summary: Hundreds of schools across Britain have been forced to close or send pupils home early as the country braces for a rare red extreme heat warning, with temperatures expected to soar to a record 40°C.

title: No decision to increase paddy purchasing price by PMB
summary: The government is likely to focus on increasing concessions given to paddy farmers rather than increasing the purchase price of paddy by the Paddy Marketing Board (PMB), Minister of Agriculture K.D. Lal Kantha told Parliament today.

title: 24-hour water cut in several areas from tonight
summary: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) has announced a 24-hour water cut in several areas, including Padukka, Homagama, Kottawa, Pannipitiya and Pelenwatte, from tonight.

title: Dengue nears 50,000 cases as islandwide control drive begins
summary: Sri Lanka has launched a three-day islandwide dengue control programme today (24) as health authorities race to contain the rapid spread of the disease, which has infected close to 50,000 people and claimed 28 lives so far this year.

title: RONALDO MAKES HISTORY: First Player to Score in Six World Cups
summary: Ronaldo makes history with a new World Cup scoring record, Donald Trump is set to present the trophy at the final, and more breaking news from World Cup 2026.

title: AKD wanted applause for a case pertaining to a traffic offence by MP on May 25: Opposition
summary: The opposition in Parliament yesterday questioned whether President Anura Kumara Dissanayake wanted people to applaud a verdict which was given against sitting MP Chaminda Wijesiri who was charged with a traffic offence.

title: Ministry mulls penalties for school canteens flouting healthy food guidelines
summary: The Ministry of Health is considering imposing penalties on school canteens that fail to comply with newly introduced healthy food guidelines aimed at promoting safe and nutritious eating habits among students, Daily Mirror learns.

title: Sri Lanka promises to make payment clearance as soon as feasible
summary: The recent US $2.5 million cyber theft from the newly established Public Debt Management Office (PDMO)—where a sovereign debt repayment to Australia was intercepted via systemic digital breaches, had a direct bearing on Sri Lanka’s programme with the International Monetary Fund (IMF), according to a top official.

title: Pope’s intervention sought by relatives of Sallay
summary: An appeal has been made to His Holiness Pope Leo XIV seeking humanitarian intervention regarding the detention of former State Intelligence Service (SIS) Director Major General (Retd.) Suresh Sallay, who is currently being held under the custody of the Criminal Investigation Department (CID).
